//Dimensions: Analytics dimensions this deployment collects. Empty on purpose: the engine must not ship
any one product's vocabulary. A deployment declares its own here, or (preferably) in its
compose/env config as TelemetryEngine__Dimensions__0__Name and friends. Each becomes a real
typed ClickHouse column, created at startup by ClickHouseSchemaMigrator.
Type is one of: String | LowCardinality | UInt64 | Int64 | DateTime.
Removing a declaration is refused at boot if the column holds data — set Retired: true to
stop collecting while keeping the column and every row.
